name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Support standard Claude Code and configured wrappers such as tclaude with exact native identity, successful Stop-hook completion evidence and compatible runtime contracts. Prefer managed terminals for ordinary new Claude Sends, retain native inbox delivery when no controllable counterpart exists, and preserve explicit physical-terminal draft replacement/handoff. Keep original task routes, input authority and uncertain-send protections. Claude permission-mode switching and native peer approval/question responses remain unavailable. Coordinate Pi 0.1.0-poc.7 and DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.10, pinned to core 0.15.0 on next.
